mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 12 degrees now, few clouds. Next 24 hours: high 16, low 11.

A massive cyberattack has compromised the websites of 178 organizations worldwide, including major outlets BBC and CNN, as well as Zoom and HSBC, exposing visitor data.

Former U.S. State Department official Luke Zahner said Kosovo has made extraordinary post-war progress, but full international recognition remains its biggest challenge.

In a German administrative error, authorities in North Rhine-Westphalia failed to list 34 Albanian nationals on a deportation flight bound for Tirana, sparking a scandal.

Nvidia founder Jensen Huang announced he is prepared to return as chief executive of the chipmaker, marking his first public statement since stepping down last Thursday.

Kosovo's national football team will wear white shirts for their decisive World Cup qualifier against the Republic of Ireland in Dublin tonight.
